findings.source_quote: "And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man –Genesis 2:21-22."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate both verses fully and accurately into Korean, preserving the two-verse content and meaning (do not add facts not in the English). Suggested Korean rendering to replace the translator's quoted material but preserving existing HTML tags and ordering: "여호와 하나님이 아담에게 깊은 잠을 내리시니 그가 잠들매 그가 그의 갈비 하나를 취하시고 그 자리를 살로 메우시고; 여호와 하나님이 취하신 그 갈비로 여자를 지으사 그를 아담에게 이끌어 오셨더라 –창세기 2:21-22." Ensure both clauses are present (the taking of one rib; the forming of a woman from that rib and bringing her to the man) and do not introduce the word "일곱(七)" or any other addition.
findings.translation_quote: "여호와 하나님이 깊은 잠을 아담에게 내리시니 그가 잠들매 그 일곱 갈비 중 하나를 취하시고 그 자리의 살을 대신하여 채우시고 –창세기 2:21-22."
